item.title: CCSD data shows improvement in suspensions, expulsions
item.description: The Clark County School District is reporting a decrease for the third straight year in the number of students suspended and expelled.

item.title: Outpost 51 Alien Museum near Las Vegas focusing on actual accounts and sightings
item.description: Visitors to a new attraction in Boulder City aren't interested in fiction, according to owner Tom Devlin. The share their own stories and are fascinated by actual accounts and stories about UFO sightings.

item.title: Las Vegas teen in alleged Costa Rica field trip assault case appears in juvenile court; Judge recuses
item.description: A teen who Las Vegas Metro police said participated in a group sexual assault against another boy appeared in a juvenile courtroom on Wednesday.

item.title: Las Vegas club promoter nearly 3 times legal limit in DUI crash involving child: police
item.description: A Las Vegas club promoter involved in a suspected DUI crash with a family visiting from the United Kingdom, which sent a child in a stroller airborne, was nearly three times the legal limit, according to documents 8 News Now obtained.

item.title: Does Las Vegas believe the fed job data?
item.description: A Las Vegas grocery store owner wished for the kind of business he had one year ago, and he isn’t quick to believe the strong federal employment rates, after firing four employees.

item.title: Valentine's Day spending expected to reach record high in Nevada, RAN says
item.description: From gourmet chocolates to romantic dinners and weekend getaways, Nevadans are preparing to celebrate Valentine's Day with meaningful gestures and carefully chosen gifts. According to the Retail Association of Nevada, Valentine's Day spending is set to reach a record high across the state.

item.title: Las Vegas man who killed elderly couple to steal their Social Security checks dies at Nevada prison
item.description: A Las Vegas man who killed an elderly couple and stole their Social Security checks died at a Northern Nevada prison, according to the Nevada Department of Corrections.

item.title: Loved ones remember Las Vegas plumber killed in motorcycle crash
item.description: LAS VEGAS (KLAS) -- The family of a Henderson man who was killed in a motorcycle crash is sharing his story, trying to raise awareness. "He never had strangers," Witnee Hord said. item.title: Video: Montana woman yells 'I will shoot' before pointing gun at Nevada trooper
item.description: A Montana woman who pointed a gun at a Nevada state trooper is heard on bodycam yelling "I will shoot" before that trooper shot at her in Las Vegas over the weekend, according to video released Wednesday.

item.title: Las Vegas man admits to killing Summerlin neighbor as teenager
item.description: A now 21-year-old Las Vegas man has pleaded guilty to leaving school and killing his Summerlin neighbor more than four years ago when he was a teenager, documents said.
